vacancy.title: Project Management and Engineering for Non-Orbital Project
vacancy.assessment: Direct onsite ESA/ESTEC role managing ESA Academy non-orbital projects across laboratories, parabolic flights, sounding rockets and balloons; coordinates university teams, ESA engineers, technical reviews, test campaigns and risk/quality. Strong match to MSc Mechanical Engineering, project ownership and ESA Academy exposure; slightly more education/event coordination than orbital role. Requires 4+ years relevant experience and PM skills. Advertised temporary; verify duration, compensation and assignment before applying.
